en-US.description:
A tick found just 10 minutes into a walk…

I realized that letting your guard down can really lead to big trouble 😥

When walking in bushes or on grass, ticks can easily attach to your dog, so please make sure to check your body thoroughly after your walk!

🔎Galaxy ver
Accessibility Visual Aid → Turn on Color Inversion → Turn on Camera and search

🔎iPhone ver
Search for Zoom → Settings → Add Filter → Turn on Zoom and search using the Inversion filter

Especially during this warming season, tick activity increases, so extra caution is needed.
